channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by remote code execution and unsafe deserialization flaws across web applications, middleware, and cloud platforms, with notable impacts on WordPress ecosystems, PHP runtimes, and Kubernetes orchestration. Significant network and storage security issues include SMB protocol race conditions, NVMe-over-Fabrics memory corruption, and confidential computing virtual machine isolation breaks that threaten multi-tenant infrastructure. Additionally, critical desktop and kernel-level flaws affecting AMD processors, Linux socket handling, and Ghostscript sandboxing highlight persistent risks in system software and developer toolchains. These findings underscore widespread exploitation vectors targeting authentication bypasses, untrusted data parsing, and resource exhaustion across enterprise and open-source stacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-134793 — Desktop OS
item.description: Electerm terminal emulator on Windows suffers from OS command injection via crafted filenames containing Unicode quotes, enabling unauthorized PowerShell execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-99592 — Desktop OS
item.description: AMD CPU global ASID collision flaw allows cross-process TLB poisoning, risking memory corruption and data leakage on modern workstations and servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-134704 — Desktop OS
item.description: OpenShot's unsafe deserialization allows attackers to execute arbitrary code by tricking users into opening crafted project files.

item.title: CVE-2026-99480 — Desktop OS
item.description: A TOCTOU race condition in the Panthor DRM driver can corrupt GPU state and crash the system during handle destruction.

item.title: CVE-2026-99454 — IoT Security
item.description: The RTL8723BS WiFi driver mishandles crafted protected frames from malicious APs, enabling denial-of-service or information disclosure on connected IoT devices.

item.title: CVE-2026-99451 — IoT Security
item.description: The MT76 WiFi driver fails to unlink rejected Time Wheel TWT flows, leading to resource leaks and potential driver instability on mobile/IoT hardware.

item.title: CVE-2026-134804 — Cloud Security
item.description: Portainer authorization bypass allows standard users to attach to and exec into other tenants' containers via WebSocket, severely impacting multi-tenant Kubernetes security.

item.title: CVE-2026-134817 — Cloud Security
item.description: Argument injection in Kubernetes MCP server allows remote clients to pass malicious flags to kubectl, escalating to cluster control and workload manipulation.

item.title: CVE-2026-99544 — Cloud Security
item.description: Unbounded VMBus ring buffer indices in confidential computing VMs allow untrusted hosts to manipulate guest memory, risking data exfiltration or escape.

item.title: CVE-2026-99346 — Cloud Security
item.description: KVM SVM fails to reset ASID generation on physical CPU switches, which can break address space isolation between co-located virtual machines.

item.title: CVE-2026-134624 — Network Devices
item.description: N-able MailAssure LDAP sync misconfiguration enables internal network probing and port scanning by authenticated API users, aiding lateral movement.

item.title: CVE-2026-99792 — Network Devices
item.description: Linux kernel SMB race condition during tree disconnect allows unauthorized file publication, exposing sensitive data over network shares.

item.title: CVE-2026-99634 — Network Devices
item.description: MPTCP Fast Open implementation flaw triggers fatal kernel crashes on MP_JOIN requests, disrupting multipath network stability and reliability.

item.title: CVE-2026-99385 — Network Devices
item.description: A buffer overflow in the SMB client during tree connection allows remote code execution via maliciously long UNC paths sent by servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-99322 — Network Devices
item.description: ksmbd incorrectly rebonds completed CREATE replays without draining old channels, causing session state corruption and potential authentication bypass.

item.title: CVE-2026-99441 — Network Devices
item.description: Concurrent DH-HMAC-CHAP authentication commands trigger a use-after-free in nvmet-auth, risking kernel panic or privilege escalation on NVMe-over-Fabrics targets.

item.title: CVE-2026-133968 — Web Security
item.description: Actively exploited directory traversal in MONAI Label enables remote code execution, posing immediate threats to AI/ML deployment pipelines and web applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-131754 — Web Security
item.description: Critical deserialization flaw in APCu Manager allows object injection, potentially leading to full WordPress site compromise and remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-131782 — Web Security
item.description: Similar high-severity deserialization vulnerability in Simple Shopping Cart exposes e-commerce platforms to critical RCE attacks via untrusted data parsing.

item.title: CVE-2026-134836 — Web Security
item.description: Flawed prefix-only origin validation in Dashy captures bearer tokens and credentials via lookalike URLs, facilitating widespread session hijacking.

item.title: CVE-2026-134813 — Web Security
item.description: Unauthenticated WebSocket clients can trigger memory exhaustion via fully inflated messages before length enforcement, disrupting real-time web services.

item.title: CVE-2026-131707 — Web Security
item.description: ProfileGrid's insecure deserialization allows object injection, enabling unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on WordPress sites.

item.title: CVE-2026-131701 — Web Security
item.description: Blind SQL injection in the WP Media folder plugin allows attackers to extract sensitive database contents or escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-134654 — Web Security
item.description: Host header injection in Mailflare's password reset handler lets attackers poison reset URLs, facilitating account takeover via phishing.

item.title: CVE-2026-93491 — Web Security
item.description: Enables remote denial-of-service via HTTP pipelining abuse that exhausts server heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-93488 — Web Security
item.description: Allows resource exhaustion by accepting unlimited concurrent SPDY streams, leading to service disruption.

item.title: CVE-2026-89059 — Web Security
item.description: Unrestricted image decoding permits unauthenticated attackers to trigger severe memory exhaustion and crashes.

item.title: CVE-2026-17615 — Web Security
item.description: Exploits external entity parsing in XML processing to enable unauthenticated remote file reads on the server.

item.title: CVE-2026-134803 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Bytebase DBHub bypasses read-only restrictions via backslash-escaped quotes, allowing unauthorized DDL and write executions that threaten database integrity.

item.title: CVE-2026-15565 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Red Hat Undertow WebSocket endpoint lacks memory limits on @OnMessage methods, enabling unauthenticated denial-of-service attacks against Java web servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-129474 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Use-after-free in PHP's magic method backtraces yields a high EPSS score, allowing remote code execution when fatal errors occur during method calls.

item.title: CVE-2026-115560 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Session serializer mismatch enables attackers to inject controlled data into PHP sessions, leading to session fixation or remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-2818 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Zip-slip path traversal in Spring Data Geode's snapshot import allows writing files outside intended directories, compromising application integrity.

item.title: CVE-2026-85634 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Missing path validation in deployment handling allows unauthorized file system access and potential code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-84725 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Bypasses security interceptors by loading arbitrary classes via malicious IIOP object unmarshalling, enabling pre-auth RCE.

item.title: CVE-2026-15560 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Identical to CVE-2026-84725; represents a duplicate entry for the same pre-auth remote code execution flaw in JBoss EAP.

item.title: CVE-2026-99676 — Other
item.description: Critical Linux kernel socket refcounting regression can cause use-after-free conditions in lockless access paths, potentially leading to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-99618 — Other
item.description: NVMe target driver leaks uninitialized memory beyond valid data in ANA log pages, exposing sensitive host storage metadata to connected initiators.

item.title: CVE-2026-99591 — Other
item.description: AMD IOMMU out-of-bounds read in device table access threatens virtualization isolation by leaking adjacent memory contents during DMA operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-99590 — Other
item.description: Ceph client parses inline data lengths without upper bounds, risking kernel memory corruption when interacting with compromised or malformed metadata servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-125396 — Other
item.description: Ghostscript bypasses the -dSAFER sandbox by exploiting type errors in .putgstringcopy, allowing privileged operators to escape restricted execution environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-134694 — Other
item.description: Gammapy passes untrusted FITS header values directly to Python's eval(), enabling arbitrary code execution when researchers load malicious astronomical datasets.
